component.name: VEGA Studio
component.summary: Desktop Firmware IDE for C-DAC VEGA ARIES V3 RISC-V

description.p: VEGA Studio is a dedicated desktop embedded firmware IDE tailored for C-DAC VEGA ARIES V3 RISC-V development boards. It integrates a live project explorer, Monaco editor, Make build orchestration, XMODEM flashing, USB-UART serial monitor, POSIX PTY terminal, Git/GitHub integration, AI assistance, and guided examples & documentation.
